questions.q:
There are total 568 students in a school. If number of girls in school are two-third more than the number of boys in the school. How many girls are there in the school?

एक विद्यालय में कुल 568 छात्र हैं। यदि विद्यालय में लड़कियों की संख्या, लड़कों की संख्या से 2/3 अधिक है, तो विद्यालय में लड़कियों की संख्या कितनी है?
questions.s:
Total number of students = 568

Let number of boys = n

Then, number of girls = (1 + 2/3) * n = 5n/3

Now, 568 = n + 5n/3

n = 213

Therefore, number of girls = 568 - 213 = 355

questions.q:
If a five digit number 325xy is divisible by 7, 9 and 11, what is the value of (3x + 4y)?

यदि पांच अंकों की संख्या 325xy, 7, 9 और 11 से विभाज्य है, तो (3x + 4y) का मान क्या है?
questions.s:
325xy is divisible by 7, 9 and 11

For divisibility by 9

(3 + 2 + 5 + x + y) is divisible by 9

10 + x + y is divisible by 9, So x + y is either 8 or 17

x + y = 8 or x + y = 17

For divisibility by 11

(3 + 5 + y) - (2 + x) is divisible by 11

6 + y - x = 0 or 11

x - y = 6 or y - x = 5

Using equations x + y = 8 and x - y = 6

we get x = 7 and y = 1

Using equations x + y = 17 and y - x = 5

we get y = 11 and x = 6

Possible case is x = 7 and y = 1

Number 32571 is divisible by 7 also

3x + 4y = 3 X 7 + 4 X 1 = 25

questions.q:
If N = 66 + 69 + 610 + 67, then how many positive factors of N are there?

यदि N = 66 + 69 + 610 + 67 है, तो N के कितने धनात्मक गुणनखंड हैं?
questions.s:
N = 66 + 69 + 610 + 67

N = 66 * (1 + 63 + 64 + 6)

N = (2 * 3)6 * [(1 + 63) + 6(1 + 63)]

N = 26 * 36 * (1 + 63) * (1 + 6)

N = 26 * 36 * 217 * 7

N = 26 * 36 * 7 * 31 * 7

N = 26 * 36 * 72 * 31

If N = ap * bq * cr [Where a, b and c are prime], then total positive factors of N = (p + 1)(q + 1)(r + 1).

Hence, positive factors of N = (6 + 1) * (6 + 1) * (2 + 1) * (1 + 1) = 7 * 7 * 3 * 2 = 294

1000 को 48 से भाग देने पर शेषफल के रूप में 40 प्राप्त होता है।

अतः अभीष्ट संख्या = 1000 +(48 - 40) = 1008

questions_hin.s_hi:
Since, 8P213Q is divisible by 9, then the sum of digit of number must be divisible by 9.

8 + P + 2 + 1 + 3 + Q

= 14 + P + Q, is divisible by 9

P + Q = 4, 13

Sum of possible values of (P + Q) = 4 + 13 = 17
